title: Integral compact-support coefficient data
statement: The coefficient data of the integral compact-support comparison, in the setting of [lem-pur-compact-support-integral-coefficient-comparison] (global finite-field datum [def-pur-conventions], $\ell\ne p$, finite extensions $E\subset F$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]): a coefficient system consists of a sheaf of rings $R_W$ on each pro-etale site together with inverse-image identifications $u^{-1}R_W\simeq R_{W'}$ for the maps of schemes, compatible with composition; a change of coefficients $R\to S$ is a compatible family of ring maps. For an open immersion $j$ the exact open coefficient square gives the open extension, its adjunction and the open restriction map. The image functor is the separately derived proper direct image after exact extension by zero, $P_R=Rp_*j_!$ for a compactification $f=pj$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements, def-weil-extension-by-zero, def-weil-derived-direct-image]; the restriction and comparison are the derived change-of-rings maps $M\otimes^L_{R}S$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] on the compact-support images, with the geometric pull/push composition identifications and the open projection inverse. The projection map is the canonical compact-support projection $P_R(M)\otimes^L K\to P_R(M\otimes^L f^*K)$ built from these comparisons [def-exchange-projection]. The completed coefficient system is $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}$ with the completed pullback maps [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], and the finite system is $\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ with its projection to the completed system. These are the objects named in the statements; the comparison isomorphism $c_{F/E}$ and its properties are the content of [lem-pur-compact-support-integral-coefficient-comparison].

proof.text: Obtain the section-normalized module direct-image composition isomorphism from proEtaleRingDerivedPullbackComposition. Two such isomorphisms have equal components on every section, hence equal homs and are equal. This proves modulePushComposition_existsUnique without choosing unnormalized data.

For projectionComparisons_existsUnique, transpose unit tensor identity and the inverse canonical tensor comparison. Adjunction naturality and tensor naturality make these components a natural transformation. Componentwise invertibility is the retained openProjectionInverse_isIso theorem. Whisker its inverse by the proper pullback, compose with geometricPullComposition and the compactification equation, then curry to construct openProjection. Curry the canonical tensor comparison to construct tensorPullback. The displayed component normalizations are definitional, and extensionality proves uniqueness of both natural isomorphisms and of the resulting structure.

The coefficient_inverse_image_iso of SfCompleteDirectImageReduction has direct-image adjunct sfCompletedCoefficientMap by coefficient_direct_image_eq. Adjunction injectivity identifies its hom with completedPullMap and transfers invertibility. This only reuses the proved coefficient-normalization helpers, not the module main theorem.

For completedPull_comp, compare the two homs after each positive finite projection. Adjunction naturality and the defining finite-projection normalization of sfCompletedCoefficientMap give completedPull_projection. Apply it twice on the composite side, move the projection through proEtaleRingInverseImageComp by naturality, and use proEtaleConstantComparison_comp. Forget commutativity faithfully and use joint monicity of the RingCat limit projections.

For completedChange_square, compare after every target finite projection. Replace both completed coefficient inclusions by their finite quotient maps using completedCoefficientMap_existsUnique. Replace both geometric pullback composites by completedPull_projection. Naturality of proEtaleConstantInverseImageMap in the quotient-ring inclusion identifies the remaining maps. Faithful forgetfulness and joint monicity of the RingCat limit projections prove the equality.

For openRestrictionMap_isIso, present both actual extensions as coefficient equivalences followed by slice extension. Subterminality gives invertible units and full faithfulness. The proved RingedOpenScalar.comparison shows that restricting scalars preserves the essential image of slice extension. Transfer through the two presentation isomorphisms, so the counit for the R-extension at the scalar-restricted S-extension is invertible. Unfold the specified mate: it is extension of the scalar restriction of the S-unit, extension of the inverse pullback/restriction square, and this counit. Every factor is invertible. No compatibility between the two chosen coefficient equivalences is needed.
